title: Toxic Yuri
description:
Toxic Yuri

What would you do if you found an abandoned sludge girl in a cardboard box? Take her home, of course!

Play as OL-san, an overworked, easily annoyed office worker living in Kyoto. She meets Doku-chan, a mysterious woman made of putrid slime and ghastly goop, and of course instantly falls in love with her. A sickly romantic comedy begins.

Play through six devilish episodes. Depending on how you treat Doku-chan, you'll get your official episode ranking: TOXIC, TONIC, or TEPID. Your choices drastically change the story. Can you live with the consequences of your actions? Yeah, I bet you can. 

Ever wanted to kiss in an onsen and get dizzy from your girlfriend's poison fumes? Ever wanted to have a cute DIY date to build her a cage? Ever wanted to get hospitalized eating her cooking? If you want a romantic comedy that features a literal dead dove, Toxic Yuri is for you.

With 10+ endings and 15+ episode variants, you'll be replaying this dark romantic comedy countless times to see all the ways your relationship with Doku-chan can unfold.

Features• A 100,000+ word visual novel with countless branching paths and hundreds of story routes.

• Fluffy anime fanfiction tropes galore. Live out the romcom of your fever dreams.

• A literally AND figuratively toxic romance!

• A super special "Don't Date the Toxic Sludge Woman" option for Tepid routes.

• 10+ endings, including some super-secret hidden ones.

• Please make this game popular so we can make a Doku-chan plushie...
description_short: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Will your relationship be healthy? Disastrous? Completely tepid? The choice is up to you in the only visual novel to prominently feature a literal dead dove.
